world.title: Saudi Arabia reopens Riyadh airport after Houthi attack kills three
world.summary: Saudi Arabia has reopened King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh after Houthi attacks resulted in three fatalities and multiple injuries. The General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) announced the reopening on social media, highlighting the recent trend of Houthi assaults targeting airports. This incident marks a continuation of escalating tensions in the region, prompting security concerns.

world.title: Buying arms, selling independence: The strategic cost of importing weapons
world.summary: Global arms sales are increasingly shaped by political dynamics, influencing nations' defense procurement strategies. Countries like India aim to preserve strategic autonomy while navigating foreign military dependencies. The situation in Turkey exemplifies the potential risks associated with reliance on imported weapons, as nations balance the need for advanced military capabilities against the implications for their independence and security.

world.title: Hours before Nobel Peace Prize announcement, Shehbaz nominated Trump again & got roasted, by Pakistanis
world.summary: In June 2025, Pakistan's Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif nominated Donald Trump for the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize, citing his "decisive diplomatic intervention" during India-Pakistan tensions. Hours before the announcement of the prize, Sharif reiterated his support for Trump, which drew criticism and mockery from Pakistanis on social media, highlighting the controversial nature of the nomination.

business.title: Apple is cutting production of the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max by 15-20% • Межа
business.summary: Apple is requesting suppliers to reduce production of components for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max by 15% to 20%. This decision is attributed to a decline in demand, which is occurring alongside increasing memory prices. The information was reported by Nikkei Asia, citing sources familiar with the situation.

business.title: Poonawalla Fincorp Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 5
business.summary: Poonawalla Fincorp Ltd reported a 406.5% year-on-year increase in net profit, reaching ₹374.8 crore for Q2FY27, compared to ₹74 crore in the same quarter last year. The company experienced significant growth in assets under management (AUM), driven by strong retail product performance. New products accounted for 18% of AUM, with a secured on-book mix of 52%.

business.title: Poonawalla Fincorp Q2 Results: Net Profit Jumps Over Five-Fold To Rs 375 Crore
business.summary: Poonawalla Fincorp Ltd. reported a net profit of Rs 375 crore for Q2, a five-fold increase year-on-year. Total income rose 70% to Rs 2,625 crore from Rs 1,543 crore. As of September 30, 2026, assets under management (AUM) reached Rs 74,008 crore. The company attributed growth to improved margins and stable asset quality.

technology.title: Apple is cutting production of the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max by 15-20% • Межа
technology.summary: Apple is requesting its suppliers to reduce production of components for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max by 15% to 20%. This decision is attributed to a decline in demand, which has been influenced by increasing memory prices. The information was reported by Nikkei Asia, citing sources familiar with the situation.

technology.title: Best EA FC 27 custom tactics from pro players
technology.summary: Pro players Tekkz and RedLac share effective custom tactics for EA Sports FC 27's Ultimate Team mode. Their recommendations include specific formations and player roles aimed at enhancing gameplay. Key strategies focus on controlling the midfield, effectively defending against through balls, and maximizing scoring opportunities. Implementing these tactics can significantly improve performance and outcomes in competitive matches.

technology.title: Deepinder Goyal Clarifies Temple Device's Age Limit: Do Under-18 Brains Need A Wearable?
technology.summary: Deepinder Goyal, founder of Zomato and Eternal, clarified that users must be at least 18 years old to register for the Temple device, as stated in the official Terms of Use. The Temple wearable is generating interest in the fitness industry and will soon be available in six colors, distinguishing itself from traditional smartwatches and fitness trackers.

sports.title: Konstas, Philippe and Johnson secure 2-0 lead for Australia A
sports.summary: Australia A secured a 2-0 lead against India A in their 2026/27 series, winning the second match by 69 runs. Australia A scored 275 runs, with Konstas contributing 67 and Philippe 58. In response, India A managed 206 runs, with Patidar scoring 67. Johnson took 3 wickets for 35 runs, while Arshad claimed 3 for India A.

sports.title: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi In 2nd India vs West Indies T20I 'Won't Happen': Why Wonderkid Still Can't Take Sanju Samson's Place
sports.summary: Sanju Samson remains a key player in the Indian cricket team despite competition from emerging talents like Vaibhav Sooryavanshi. Samson's impressive performance in the T20 World Cup, where he scored three consecutive half-centuries, highlights his value. However, maintaining a spot in the team is challenging, and Sooryavanshi's opportunity to replace him in the second T20I against West Indies is uncertain.

sports.title: Local boy Kishan returns to the ground where he found himself again
sports.summary: Ishan Kishan, once removed from all three India squads and without a central contract, has successfully rebuilt his career in Ranchi. He returns to the city as a celebrated star, marking a significant turnaround in his professional journey. Kishan's resurgence highlights his determination and resilience, showcasing his ability to overcome challenges and regain his position in cricket.

health.title: One human protein helps malaria and kala-azar thrive. JNU scientists took it out
health.summary: Scientists at Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU) have discovered that destroying the human protein p38-MAPK in lab cells significantly weakens the parasites responsible for malaria and kala-azar. In contrast, merely switching off the protein had no effect. While this research offers a new perspective on potential treatments for these diseases, it remains in the early stages of investigation.

health.title: Needle-Shy? Ask Them To Pump Up Your Jam, Study Suggests
health.summary: A study suggests that listening to favorite music can help reduce pain during needle procedures, such as IV insertions. Patients reported better pain management when their preferred songs were played, making the experience more tolerable. This finding highlights the potential benefits of music as a therapeutic tool in medical settings, particularly for individuals who are anxious about needles.

health.title: Leading dentists redefining modern dentistry through innovation, impact and exce
health.summary: Leading dentists are transforming modern dentistry through innovative treatments and education. They focus on advanced techniques and community impact, exemplified by Dr. Shilfa Nigar, who has provided thousands of free orthognathic surgeries to underprivileged patients. His contributions to social service have earned him the President of India’s Gold Medal twice, highlighting the importance of social responsibility in oral healthcare.

science.title: Local chromatin motion remains nearly constant throughout interphase
science.summary: Research by the Maeshima and Kanemaki groups reveals that average local nucleosome motion in living human cells remains nearly constant throughout interphase. The study highlights the role of linker histone H1, which acts as a liquid-like adhesive to organize chromatin. These findings contribute to the understanding of chromatin dynamics and its implications for gene regulation and cellular function.

science.title: Alemnis Pushes Micromechanical Testing to 100,000 s⁻¹ with True Displacement Control
science.summary: Alemnis has achieved a significant advancement in high-strain-rate micromechanical testing by reaching controlled indentation strain rates of up to 100,000 s⁻¹. This development allows for constant strain rates while ensuring accurate load-displacement measurements. The innovation enhances the precision and reliability of micromechanical testing, potentially benefiting various applications in materials science and engineering.

science.title: Orionids Meteor Shower To Appear In UAE Skies This October; Here's Where To Watch Them!
science.summary: The Orionids Meteor Shower will be visible in the UAE on October 21st and 22nd. This annual event occurs when cosmic debris enters the Earth's atmosphere, creating a spectacular display. Observers in the region can look forward to witnessing this celestial phenomenon. Details on optimal viewing locations and times will be provided to enhance the experience for spectators.

entertainment.title: How Nana Patekar once helped Shah Rukh Khan get out of jail: ‘He was very sweet’
entertainment.summary: Shah Rukh Khan recounted how Nana Patekar assisted him in securing bail after a confrontation with a journalist led to his arrest early in his career. The incident stemmed from a magazine article suggesting Khan had a romantic relationship with a co-star, which upset his then-girlfriend, Gauri Khan. Patekar's support during this challenging time was appreciated by Khan.

entertainment.title: Rajkummar Rao REACTS to Dada poster criticism: “Makers have learnt their lesson”
entertainment.summary: Rajkummar Rao responded to the criticism of the first-look poster for the biopic "Dada," based on former Indian cricket captain Sourav Ganguly. The poster, released on July 8 for Ganguly's birthday, faced mixed reactions. Rao stated that the makers have learned from the feedback and are taking it into account for future promotional materials.

entertainment.title: Saif Ali Khan's sister Saba Pataudi was diagnosed with brain tumour at the age of 27: 'I didn’t want to be dependent on anyone, didn't want to become a vegetable'
entertainment.summary: Saba Pataudi, sister of Saif and Soha Ali Khan, revealed her brain tumour diagnosis at 27, which led her to seek independence and avoid becoming reliant on others. Despite being part of a prominent film family, she has remained largely out of the public eye. In a rare appearance, she shared her personal health struggles and determination.
